utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still happening today — I’m heading over there soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — just checking. What time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time so I don’t mix anything up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — the repair drive is at the community shed by Maple and 3rd, this Saturday from 10 to 2. If you want, I can text you the exact drop-off list too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — could you text me the exact drop-off list too?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — I’m lining up the repair drive now, and I can use a hand with the list and timing. What part do you want to help with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the timing and show up late to handle the last stretch. Send me the list and I’ll plug in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll send you the list and the schedule, and I’ll count on you for the last stretch. Thanks, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up—what’s the latest on what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: They still need a few basic tools, some extension cords, and folks willing to lend a hand for the morning shift. If you’ve got anything to spare, I can help get it over there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can check around for a couple extension cords and see if anyone’s free for the morning shift. If you hear of anything else they’re short on, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you can bring a screwdriver, some tape, and a bit of patience, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring a screwdriver, tape, and patience.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great — thanks for spreading the word. Let me know if you want me to help with anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll talk to a few more neighbors and keep you posted if anyone can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in — I’ll spread the word right away and see who can pitch in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a list of what we need, and you can let folks know when and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — send me the list, and I’ll get the invitation out to everyone I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already—people are dropping off tools and supplies this afternoon. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, that’s a relief. Thanks, Tess — I’ll swing by later and see if there’s anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll let you know if they end up needing extra hands or a few more odds and ends.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m thinking we should keep it after pickup so the parking lot’s less crowded—maybe around 4:30? I just want to make sure the timing won’t create a mess.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 sounds sensible to me—I can help keep it after pickup so we avoid the rush.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting a few more donations today—want me to check if they still need drop-offs?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, please check for me—I can swing by if they still need drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll ask while I’m out and let you know if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might've missed a few details, but I'm happy to help if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah. I’ll let you know what still needs doing, and any help would be appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—just point me at whatever’s left, and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we get enough volunteers for the repair drive, or should I start asking a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’d ask a few more neighbors just to be safe — it’s better to have a little extra help than come up short.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll ask a few more neighbors so we have a buffer.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. Do we have the list and a place to drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t seen the full list yet, but I can ask around and see where folks want everything dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, thanks. Once we know the drop-off spot, I can sort out my part.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Gus—are we still doing the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, we’re still on for this afternoon — I’ve got my tools ready and I can bring a few extras too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what time are we meeting for the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s meet at 10:00 by the community center parking lot, and bring work gloves plus any basic tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I'll be there at 10:00 with gloves and my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to head to the repair drive later, and I’ll pass that along if anyone asks. If you want, I can remind folks to bring what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Vik—people will really appreciate the reminder. I’ll spread the word too and let folks know to bring their broken stuff.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Tess—I’ll keep repeating the plan and remind folks to bring their broken stuff later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Rosa — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, and you’re warmly invited. If you can make it, I’d love to see you there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — that sounds lovely. I’ll do my best to come and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Rosa — thank you! I’ll save you a spot and keep you posted with the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — we could really use screwdrivers, duct tape, and a couple sturdy flashlights most of all.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll grab some screwdrivers and duct tape, and I can bring a couple flashlights too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a few things by for the repair drive, but I’ll need to keep it quiet on my end.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works, thanks — I’ll keep your name off the list and just coordinate the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I appreciate you keeping it discreet — I’ll text when I’m ready to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—just tell me what needs fixing and when to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Leo — I’ll send you the repair list and the time window once I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over some of my extra tape, nails, and a flashlight for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks — just bring whatever you can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll grab them and head over soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you want—just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Jules—thank you. Could you share the date, time, and that we’re looking for tools, volunteers, and any broken items people want fixed?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll share that it’s on the repair drive date and time, and that you’re looking for tools, volunteers, and broken items to fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what’s needed most right now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey—I'm a bit scattered today, but I think we mostly need tools, a few screws, and someone willing to lift the heavier stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that—I'll bring what tools I have and help with the lifting.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d want to double-check the latest details before I say for sure — what’s the newest update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure yet either — I probably missed the update. If you heard anything, can you fill me in?
